statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness
There is concern for an underlying arrhythmia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was billed
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73, R00.2, and R42
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
CPT 93229 is indicated to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources or symptomatic dysrhythmias
